description: On a Garajonay trail the ancient laurel trunks arch overhead, draped in moss, while low mist drifts between the ferns — 69% model cloud and the island's famous horizontal rain make this mood honest. Faint moonlight filters through the canopy in soft shafts, the only light in the forest. It is the primeval laurisilva at night, rendered as a restrained long-exposure interpretation.
